tasks.label: JackalSimulator: Generate Solver
tasks.command: source fix_console.sh && cd src/mpc_planner && python3 -m poetry run python mpc_planner_jackalsimulator/scripts/generate_jackalsimulator_solver.py

tasks.label: JackalSimulator: Build
tasks.command: ./build.sh jackalsimulator

tasks.label: JackalSimulator: Generate solver and build
tasks.detail: Generate the solver and build mpc_planner_jackalsimulator
tasks.command: ./build.sh jackalsimulator true

tasks.label: guidance_planner_multi_robot_nodes: build
tasks.command: ./build_other_packages.sh guidance_planner_multi_robot_nodes

tasks.label: JackalSimulator: Run Simulator
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/noetic/setup.sh && source /workspace/devel/setup.bash && source /workspace/fix_console.sh && roslaunch mpc_planner_jackalsimulator ros1_jackalsimulator.launch

tasks.label: JulesJackalSimulator: Run Simulator
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/noetic/setup.sh && source /workspace/devel/setup.bash && source /workspace/fix_console.sh && roslaunch bring_up_multi_robot_scenarios ros1_launch_multiple_jack_world_v2.launch

tasks.label: ROS Navigation: Generate Solver
tasks.command: source fix_console.sh && cd src/mpc_planner && python3 -m poetry run python mpc_planner_rosnavigation/scripts/generate_rosnavigation_solver.py

tasks.label: ROS Navigation: Build
tasks.detail: Build the mpc package ROS Navigation
tasks.command: ./build.sh rosnavigation

tasks.label: ROS Navigation: Generate solver and build
tasks.detail: Generate the solver and build the mpc package configured in build.sh
tasks.command: source fix_console.sh && ./build.sh rosnavigation true

tasks.label: ROS Navigation: Run Simulator
tasks.command: source devel/setup.bash && source fix_console.sh && roslaunch mpc_planner_rosnavigation ros1_rosnavigation.launch

tasks.label: Run Tests
tasks.command: source devel/setup.bash && cd src/mpc_planner && python3 -m poetry run python -m pytest solver_generator/test/ --cov-report term --cov-config=solver_generator/test/.coveragerc --cov --cov-fail-under=70
